en_title: Final Fantasy Producer Cites Star Wars as a Key Inspiration for Characters and Mechanics in Franchise
cn_title: 《最终幻想》制作人称《星球大战》是系列角色与机制的重要灵感来源
opus_summary: 《Final Fantasy》系列制作人Yoshinori Kitase表示，《星球大战》对该系列影响很大。他称，《Final Fantasy 7》中的Wedge和Biggs以及《Final Fantasy 10》中的Blitzball都受到《星球大战》启发，并表示自己一直小心避免直接照搬。

paragraphs.en: Longtime Final Fantasy producer Yoshinori Kitase revealed to IGN that Star Wars was a big influence on the RPG franchise.
paragraphs.cn: 长期担任《最终幻想》制作人的北濑佳范向IGN透露，《星球大战》对这一RPG系列产生了很大影响。

paragraphs.en: When speaking with IGN's Michael Peyton at the Lucca Comics & Games Festival 2026, Kitase was asked how he felt about Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 being heavily influenced by Final Fantasy. He admitted that he was really happy to see a game that was inspired by Square's RPG franchise have so much success, and that he himself is heavily inspired by other entertainment behemoths, too — namely Star Wars.
paragraphs.cn: 在Lucca Comics & Games Festival 2026上与IGN的Michael Peyton交谈时，Kitase被问及对《光与影：33号远征队》深受《最终幻想》影响有何感想。他表示，看到一款受Square旗下RPG系列启发的游戏取得如此大的成功，他真的很高兴；他自己也深受其他娱乐巨作的启发，尤其是《星球大战》。

paragraphs.en: "To be honest, I know the game," Kitase said of Expedition 33. "I spoke with the creators and I'm actually very happy about the fact that they have been so inspired by Final Fantasy and they created a new game from that. And also, I was inspired by movies and in particular by Star Wars when I was young.
paragraphs.cn: 谈到《光与影：33号远征队》，Kitase说：「说实话，我知道这款游戏。我和创作者们聊过，对于他们从《最终幻想》中获得这么多启发，并以此创作出一款新游戏，我其实非常高兴。另外，我年轻时也受到过电影的启发，尤其是《星球大战》。

paragraphs.en: "I took inspiration from many things I was interested in when I was younger, and I used that inspiration to create my games. I think it's beautiful that there's this kind of cycle where we inspire each other and we take things from each other's games. I think it's something beautiful, and it should be like that."
paragraphs.cn: 「我从年轻时感兴趣的许多事物中汲取灵感，并用这些灵感创作我的游戏。我认为这种循环很美妙：我们互相启发，从彼此的游戏中汲取东西。我觉得这很美妙，本来就应该如此。」

paragraphs.en: The producer noted that he has always been careful not to lift directly from Star Wars, fearing that it would be too obvious and resemble more of a copy than anything else. However, he did point to a few things in his own work that were born from his love of the sci-fi series. He noted that Final Fantasy 7 characters Wedge and Biggs are the most overt inspirations, since they are named after characters from Star Wars' rebellion.
paragraphs.cn: 这位制作人指出，他一直小心避免直接照搬《星球大战》，担心那样会过于明显，看起来更像是在抄袭。不过，他确实指出了自己作品中几个源于他对这一科幻系列热爱的元素。他提到，《最终幻想7》中的角色Wedge和Biggs是最明显的例子，因为他们以《星球大战》中反抗军的角色命名。

paragraphs.en: On a slightly more subtle note, he also noted that Blitzball from Final Fantasy 10 was inspired by Podracing from Star Wars: The Phantom Menace.
paragraphs.cn: 他还提到了一个稍微隐晦一些的例子：《最终幻想10》中的Blitzball受到了《星球大战前传1：幽灵的威胁》中Podracing的启发。

paragraphs.en: "One more that came to my mind is from Final Fantasy X, where I had to create [Blitzball] for the game inside the fantasy setting. And I used an idea from Star Wars Episode 1 where there's this [pod] race and the fact of using sport inside a fantasy context, I took this idea directly from Star Wars."
paragraphs.cn: 「我想到的另一个例子来自《最终幻想X》，当时我必须为游戏创作一项符合奇幻背景的［Blitzball］。我用了《星球大战前传1》中的一个想法，那里有这种［飞梭］竞赛；在奇幻背景中使用体育运动这一点，我直接借鉴了《星球大战》的想法。」

paragraphs.en: The highly-awaited conclusion to the Final Fantasy 7 remake trilogy, Final Fantasy 7 Revelation, is set to release on April 8, 2027 .
paragraphs.cn: 备受期待的《最终幻想7》重制三部曲终章《最终幻想7 Revelation》预定于2027年4月8日发售。
